description: This file defines a custom exception class named EmptyBasketOnCheckoutException used in the eShopOnWeb application's core application layer to signal an attempt to checkout with an empty basket.

classes.name: EmptyBasketOnCheckoutException
classes.description: A custom exception class that extends System.Exception to indicate an attempt to checkout with an empty basket.

methods.name: EmptyBasketOnCheckoutException()
methods.description: Default constructor that initializes the exception with a specific message indicating the basket cannot be empty.

methods.name: EmptyBasketOnCheckoutException(System.Runtime.Serialization.SerializationInfo, System.Runtime.Serialization.StreamingContext)
methods.description: Serialization constructor for deserializing the exception.

methods.name: EmptyBasketOnCheckoutException(string message, Exception innerException)
methods.description: Constructor allowing custom error message and inner exception.
